_about: The view of Paris through the café window, shared by every interior style.
skyline_at: where the distant rooftops start, as a share of the window's height (0 top, 1 bottom).
colors: the city's colors in full daylight; the game dims and tints them for the hour.
eiffel: the tower's tip. x is its position across the window (0 left, 1 right).
Its golden lights come on once the café lamps are brighter than lights_on_when_lamps_above,
go off at lights_off_at, and can't come back on before lights_never_before.
It sparkles for sparkle_minutes at the top of every evening hour, up to last_sparkle.
seed: change it to rearrange the generated rooftops.
